## What's Changed
* Added bottle moves between directories and a destination picker when duplicating bottles.
* Added per-bottle notes and library sorting by bottle name.
* Added Default, Application and System DPI scaling modes in Advanced Display Settings.
* Added optional UMU controls, support for launch wrappers and download status in the library.
* Added a playtime reset button and warnings for missing program files without removing shortcuts.
* Fixed interrupted downloads on slow connections with a longer read timeout and bounded retries.
* Fixed startup delays, repeated Battle.net launches and saving imported bottles on external drives.
* Fixed Windows XP selection on 64-bit bottles and switching between Fsync and NTSync.
* Fixed restoring the Windows version after dependency installation, dependency progress and multiple uninstallers.
* Fixed Wine server shutdown and added an installer option to stop completed sessions.
* Fixed GL32 debug symbol mounts and exposed the selected Wine executable to launch scripts.
* Updated the experimental Soda catalogs and installer progress logs.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/bottlesdevs/Bottles/compare/67.5...67.6
